newsitem.title: USA: Urohealth, Imagyn Medical, to merge.
newsitem.headline: Urohealth, Imagyn Medical, to merge.

text.p: Urohealth Systems Inc said Monday it agreed for Imagyn Medical Inc to be merged into Urohealth in a stock swap.
The boards of directors of both companies have unanimously approved the deal.
Urohealth said it expects the merger to be tax-free to Imagyn shareholders and to be accounted for as a pooling of interests.
Under terms of the deal, Imagyn shareholders will receive 1.0358 shares of Urohealth for each share of Imagyn.
Urohealth said it anticipates issuing approximately 8.5 million shares to complete the exchange.
Pending shareholder approval from both companies and clearance under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Act, the transaction is expected to close by the end of June.
